## EcclesiaOS v1.0.64

### Website Studio widget controls

- Added left, center, and right justification controls for divider widgets.
- Added adjustable font sizes for heading and text widgets, with safe 10–120 px limits.
- Added a transparent background option for icon widgets.
- Preserved existing responsive typography and left-aligned divider behavior for previously saved content.
- Validated all new widget settings before rendering them on public church websites.

### Verification

- The Website Studio feature suite passes with 12 tests and 384 assertions.
- Git whitespace checks pass.
- No database migration is required.
